description: This is the main entry point for a React-based web application's frontend, setting up the rendering of the App component within a StrictMode wrapper and attaching it to the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root element.
